[Section] General Experimental Setup
[source_id=53] For the neural projector, we employ rectified networks as coupling function INLINEFORM0 following BIBREF16 . We use a rectified network with an input layer, one hidden layer, and linear output units, the number of hidden units is set to the same as the number of input units. The number of coupling layers are varied as 4, 8, 16 for both tasks. We optimize marginal data likelihood directly using Adam BIBREF22 . For both tasks in the fully unsupervised setting, we do not tune the hyper-parameters using supervised data.
